entities.name: Vladimir Grbić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir "Vanja" Grbić is a Serbian former volleyball player and three-time Olympian. He is 193 cm and played as passer-side attacker. Widely regarded as one of the greatest volleyball players of all time, Grbić was inducted into the International Volleyball Hall of Fame in 2011.
